description: Address generator that walks sixteen steps as a Markov chain, with the chance of every move taken from polyphonic inputs

params.text: Sets the seed the random generator takes on a reset, so the same walk comes back, 0 to 1
Sets the address space the step number is spread over, 2 to 32; use 16 to address TD4

inputs.text: The chances of moving from that step to each of the sixteen steps, one channel per destination, 0-10V weighting each; the sixteen weights are scaled so they add up to one
Each rising edge picks the next step from the chances of the step the chain has reached
A rising edge sends the chain back to the first step, reseeds the random generator from the Seed value and blocks the clock for 1ms
Sets the seed, 0-10V across the whole range, and overrides the Seed knob while a reset arrives

outputs.text: The step the chain has reached as a voltage, the address space spread over 0-10V
A 1ms trigger on the channel of a step when the chain arrives at it
Passes the clock through on the channel of the step the chain has reached, and 0V on the other fifteen
Carries 10V on the channel of the step the chain has reached and 0V on the other fifteen

notes: the chain only moves when the step probability inputs carry voltage; with none of them patched every weight is zero and the chain stays on the first step

inputs.16: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.17: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
